title: Balochistan Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 2003

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Assembly Members Salaries and Allowances Amendment Act 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2003
ACT III OF 2003
BALOCHISTAN
MEMBERS
(SALARIES AND
ALLOWANCES) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003
An Act further to
amend the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary 26th February, 2003]
No.PAB/Legis.V(3)/2003, dated
26-2-2003.--The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances)
(Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 25th February, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Assembly Members
(Salaries and Allowances) (Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

No.PAB/Legis.V(3)/2003, dated
26-2-2003.--The Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries and Allowances)
(Amendment) Bill, 2003 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
Balochistan on 25th February, 2003 and assented to by the Governor of
Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly:--
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
11. Insertion of new section
10 in Act II of 1975.--
Official Transport for Chairman
of Committee.
A Member who holds the office of
a Chairman of a Committee of Assembly, other than that of a Select Committee or
a Special Committee shall be entitled to the use of not more than one official
car regardless of his entitlement to have an official car in any other capacity
and where he avails himself of this facility, he shall not be entitled to
receive the conveyance allowance:
Provided that:
(i) only one car
shall be provided to a chairman of a (***) Committee during the whole term of
his office;
(ii) A Chairman
of a (***) Committee shall be allowed "five thousand rupees" per
month as POL charges.
